# Lending desk glossary

## Hold

A member's claim on a copy that is not on the shelf. A hold expires three days after it is placed. A hold can be extended once, by three days, and only by the member who placed it.

## Loan

A copy checked out to a member. A loan is not a hold: placing a hold never creates a loan.

## Renewal

Moving a loan's due date 14 days later. A loan can be renewed twice; a loan with a hold on its copy cannot be renewed.
